headings.usage: Use for H1, H2, hero banners, and large numbers.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, labels, form inputs, and small text.

layouts.general: Mobile-first, responsive grids. Asymmetric layouts for marketing pages, dense 'Bento' style for the dashboard.
layouts.dashboard_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Top row for summary cards (col-span-1), Middle row for weekly program overview (col-span-2 or 3).
layouts.marketing_grid: The 'Tetris' grid. Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Hero section col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid strokes (border-white/10) instead of soft shadows. Sharp and tactical.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky headers. bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and border-b border-white/10. Do not use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: High contrast. Hovering cards slightly lift (-translate-y-1) with primary color border glow.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) on main backgrounds to give a tactile, gritty sports magazine feel.

components.buttons: Sharp corners or very slight rounding (rounded-sm). High saturation primary color for primary actions. Text color black for contrast on primary yellow/gold buttons.
components.cards: Flat solid background (#141414), 1px border. No drop shadow. Tactical look.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. Dark backgrounds for inputs with white borders on focus.
components.icons: lucide-react for sharp, clear visual indicators.

motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (framer-motion).
motion.hover: transition-transform duration-200, scale 1.02 on interactive cards.
motion.lists: Staggered entrance animations for the 10-week drill lists.

images.description: High energy action shot of a basketball player dunking. Use in the marketing landing page hero section.
Player in daytime court. Good for the 'Create Program' onboarding flow.
Coach and team. Use in the dashboard or session view to represent coaching and progress.
Shadowy player dribbling. Good as a muted background or card image for the drills library.

media.image_treatment: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50. If overlay needed for text, use gradient overlay from-black/80 to-transparent rather than flat black.

GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
instructions_to_main_agent: Always use the provided JSON theme colors in your Tailwind configuration. Stick to the Australian Green and Gold athletic theme with Obsidian dark mode backgrounds.
Never use purely transparent headers if content scrolls behind them; use the defined glassmorphism settings.
Implement FIBA rules / NBL context within the placeholder copy and program logic. Example: references to 'Boomers', 'Opals', 'NBL1', 'Basketball Australia Pathways'.
Keep spacing generous (p-6, p-8) and avoid cramped UIs. Remember the tactical sports aesthetic.
For the PDF Export feature, ensure you implement a clean export view for the 10-week plan.
Create a toggle or distinct UI for Mens/Womens basketball in the builder form.
Ensure 'mark session complete' interaction is highly visible and satisfying (use a strong accent color and animation).
Ensure the curated drill library is populated with static JSON data referencing skills from fundamental to professional.
For the UI, avoid generic SaaS designs. Follow 'The Performance Pro' archetype: high contrast cards, sharp edges, and metric-first presentation.
